workload: Patchsentry own release QA; actual backend release tests on read-only copies of the candidate
baseline: Existing CI/tool-assisted deterministic release suite, same tests and resources
oracle: Predetermined code mutation and healthy label; existing tests are frozen before execution
partition: Internal development challenge, not independent held-out customer qualification

cases.label: defect
cases.expected: A decrypted payload with a mismatched receipt digest is rejected

metrics.detection: Nonzero suite exit with assertion failures; syntax/infrastructure errors are invalid trials, not detected defects
metrics.miss: Valid defect mutation with all assertions passing
metrics.flaky: Disagreement across identical healthy repeated executions
metrics.AI: Separate blocked evaluation; no inference key or local service available
